title: 你现在负责本项目的 Phase -1：
boundary: Phase preamble and objective; assessed by the following sections.

title: 0. 核心原则
boundary: Failure-first principles are followed by current selection, but retrospective evidence cannot prove original execution order.

title: 1. 先检查现有 repo
boundary: All four available GitHub refs and their histories were searched; exact historical algorithms remain unavailable outside current reference implementations.

title: 2. Dataset 选择评分体系
boundary: Fourteen retrospective A-H scorecards are inspectable; their timing before acquisition/training is not proven.

title: 3. 强制研究以下候选
boundary: Mandatory candidates were researched and bounded; historical DS2 archive identity and some secondary provenance remain incomplete.

title: 4. Failure → Benchmark 映射
boundary: Capability mapping is explicit and missing axes remain N/A; this does not validate every proposed secondary dataset.

title: 5. 不要一次全下载
boundary: Tiered acquisition is represented in the manifest, but original tier-by-tier timing is not reconstructable.

title: Tier 0：metadata only
boundary: Metadata-only candidate evidence is retained.

title: Tier 1：核心 benchmark
boundary: Six core archives are present and size checked; exact historical DS2 is absent.

title: Tier 2：验证 / secondary
boundary: Secondary candidates are scored; not every candidate was downloaded because capability gaps and cost boundaries are recorded.

title: Tier 3：large / future
boundary: Large/future sources remain deferred with cost evidence.

title: 6. 下载安全规则
boundary: Staged paths, sizes and extraction boundaries are recorded; old acquisition logs cannot prove every transient download safety step.

title: 7. 下载目录
boundary: Raw/processed/report paths are explicit and raw archives are not committed.

title: 8. 每个 dataset 下载后立即 sanity check
boundary: Six native sanity reports and 36 plot hashes were reverified on the fixed sample policy.

title: 9. 标签映射不要强行统一
boundary: Native labels and strict common-label mappings are separated.

title: 10. Channel topology 也必须记录
boundary: Known channel topology and unknown geometry are recorded without fabricating rings.

title: 11. 最终不要凭感觉决定“最好”
boundary: A-H comparisons are evidence bounded; exact historical DS2 still prevents a complete final ranking.

title: 12. 最终最重要的原则
boundary: The selected suite covers complementary failures, with explicit confounds and unsupported axes.

title: 13. 本阶段完成标准
boundary: Required discovery artifacts are present and hashed; historical DS2 identity and original phase ordering remain unproven.

title: 你现在要在现有 EMG/IMU Human-in-the-loop 项目上开展一轮新的“Feature Bank + Personal Calibration”系统性实验。
boundary: Experiment objective preamble; assessed by the following sections.

title: 一、研究目标
boundary: The report answers the research questions with negative as well as positive results; exact historical-family evidence is incomplete.

title: 二、核心评价思想
boundary: Held-out delta loss/F1/Brier proxies are delivered; they are not direct conditional mutual-information estimates.

title: 三、首先做数据与实验能力审计
boundary: Native capabilities and N/A boundaries are explicit; a later single-participant own-device exploratory study does not meet formal acceptance.

title: 四、冻结 baseline 和 split
boundary: Current runs preserve splits/config/state; exact old DS2/X1-H/RLCS/CES/Frequency artifacts cannot be frozen because they were not recovered.

title: 五、本轮 Feature Bank 家族
boundary: F0-F9 APIs and candidate formulas are audited; several historical identities and native calibrated-body evidence remain unavailable.

title: 六、Personal Calibration v0
boundary: Personal calibration and supported budgets are evaluated across native tasks; unsupported budgets and own-device validation remain explicit.

title: 七、校准后的简单融合
boundary: Independent calibrated providers, source OOF temperatures, reliability shrinkage and late fusion have native evidence; no universal gain is claimed.

title: 八、Feature screening：不要跑 2^N
boundary: Finite staged screening, complementarity and selected interactions are delivered; exact historical named pairs remain unavailable.

title: 九、Feature family 最终角色分类
boundary: Family roles are interpreted per failure/calibration; exact historical families prevent a final universal taxonomy.

title: 十、评价指标
boundary: Requested classification and calibration metrics are present where supported; confidence intervals are not available for every legacy run.

title: 十一、系统级评价：Robustness Vector
boundary: Seven available axes report mean and minimum boundaries; own-device real-noise and unavailable native axes remain N/A.

title: 十二、Calibration burden
boundary: 0/1/2/5-shot costs and unsupported budgets are recorded without pooling incompatible protocols.

title: 十三、必须防止的错误
boundary: Leakage-sensitive tests and split/hash audits pass; tests cannot prove historical execution order or hardware accuracy.

title: 十四、推荐执行顺序
boundary: All phases have current evidence, but retrospective recovery cannot prove the original chronological order.

title: 十五、输出文件
boundary: All named files exist and canonical rows preserve sources; schema is complete with explicit evidence N/A fields.

title: 十六、本轮最重要的科研问题
boundary: A-H questions have evidence-bounded answers; real-device and historical-family gaps constrain conclusions.

title: 十七、当前先验，不要擅自改写
boundary: Prior claims are retained as historical statements and separated from current reference evidence.

title: 十八、工程要求
boundary: Engineering clauses have focused evidence; full scientific acceptance is assessed separately.

title: 六、Personal Calibration v0：精确定义
boundary: Personal normalization/prototypes/reliability/shrinkage are implemented with held-out native evidence; not every dataset supports every budget.

title: 七、Session Calibration v0

title: 八、Late Fusion：精确定义
boundary: Late fusion contracts, quality weighting and explicit Unknown are tested and replayed; current Unknown rule has no demonstrated accuracy gain.

title: 九、对 feature family 的额外诊断

title: 十、特别重要的实现边界
